paragraphs: Palo Alto Networks sells cybersecurity products across network, cloud, security operations, AI and identity. The company says more than 70,000 customers use them, backed by its Unit 42 threat intelligence group.

Its network security platform monitors, analyzes and prevents sophisticated threats in real time with less complexity. An identity platform adds a control plane that discovers risk, applies privilege dynamically and governs access from first session to last. In a May 2026 release the company announced it had closed its acquisition of Portkey, described as a pioneer in AI gateways. That gateway watches token usage against runaway costs and adds runtime protection against malicious or unintended AI behavior.

Customer stories are filed by industry, and state and local government is one of the categories. One story describes VINCI standardising on Cortex XDR across 200,000 endpoints worldwide. The company runs executive briefing centers where customers meet its executives and product leaders. Briefings run from half a day to several days and are tailored to the visiting organization. Palo Alto Networks is listed on the Nasdaq under PANW.
